state_contract.revision_rule: Every successful state-changing command advances the monotonic page context revision.
state_contract.deictic_rule: A context-bound command must reject execution when its captured context_revision is stale.
state_contract.research_workspace_field: research_workspace is a bounded summary of local-only, non-authoritative session state
state_contract.selection_semantics: selected exposes a stable ID plus semantic kind, source references, and available authority, review, canon, and confidence posture
state_contract.proposal_rule: A staged proposal is local, traceable to a hypothesis, source/evidence refs, context revisions, and a projection fingerprint; it remains pending human review and can never become canon through this command surface.

shared_actuation_rule: Human UI handlers and WebMCP tools invoke this same command registry.
authority_limit: Commands may change browser presentation and local research-session state but never ToS source, candidate intake, review, rights, or canon state.
